tools.name: open_editor
tools.description: Opens pixel art in SpriteForge's compact pixel editor - pencil, eraser, fill, colour picker, palette, undo and animation frames - as an interactive card where the app shows them, and returns an edit link (the same editor in a browser) and a session_id. No account needed. One source at most: png_base

tools.name: get_sprite
tools.description: Returns the current state of a SpriteForge edit session: a preview image, its size and palette, how many edits were saved, and a PNG URL with the exact pixels at 1x (add &frame=N for another frame). With include_pixels it also returns the palette-index grid. Read-only.

tools.name: open_full_editor
tools.description: Opens a sprite in SpriteForge's full pixel editor - layers, selection and move, line/rectangle/ellipse, mirror painting, brush sizes, animation frames with onion skin and playback, palette tools - as an interactive card where the app shows them, and returns an edit link that opens the same editor in

tools.name: open_tileset_editor
tools.description: Opens a tileset in SpriteForge's tileset editor as an interactive card where the app shows them, and returns an edit link that opens the same editor in a browser. tools.name: load_art
tools.description: Loads an edit session's sprite into the SpriteForge editor card. Only the card calls it.

tools.name: save_art
tools.description: Saves the user's edits from the SpriteForge editor card to its edit session. Only the card calls it.
